acceptancePolicy.hashScope: Exact manifest bytes and every declared artifact, entrypoint, result, acceptance proof and check log.

journey.action: Inspect the card/token tray design and fabrication review; print the prime's blank operator kit if useful.
journey.handoff: Digital geometry and review files are not a fabricated, certified or inspected physical product.

journey.action: Inspect the artifact-only handoff and maintenance utility, then verify the saved integration snapshot.
journey.handoff: Carry file references and reproducible checks, never another organization's stores, membership or signing authority.
